title: Canonical closure coefficient Chern exchange
statement:
theorem scalar_chern_base_change_chern_none_canonical
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (family : Family l Y) (r : Reference l Y δ family)
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (hP : IsUnit (l : Γ(ProjectiveLine Y, ⊤))) :
    ∃ a : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l Y ⟶
      r.tq.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧),
      CompletedChernNormalized l r.tq.toPresentation a ∧
    ∃ b : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l (ProjectiveLine Y) ⟶
      r.t₂.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (diagonalSurface Y)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧),
      CompletedChernNormalized l r.t₂.toPresentation b ∧
      (let Λ := (coefficient l none).X
       let cq := scalarQChern l none Y r a
       let c₂ := scalarP2Chern l none Y r b
       let F := moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)
       F.map cq ≫ secondTraceExchange l none k p hpl Y =
           (scalarUnitPullIso Λ Y).hom ≫ c₂)

source.place: Canonical closure-coefficient exchange before replacing the witnesses by arbitrary normalized lifts.

proof.text: Construct normalized q and p2 completed Chern lifts using diagonalTrace_completedChern_lift. These named witnesses satisfy exactly the required whole-system normalization equations.

At E = bottomField l form the two explicit integral-to-rational Chern adjuncts x and y. Apply scalar_chern_base_change_chern_some_raw. Remove the finite unit and canonical p2 pushforward isomorphisms to identify the base-changed adjunct z with y, using associativity and the isomorphism inverse laws.

Apply closure_exchange_naturality to x, family.rational E, family.closure and family.toClosure E. Transport z = y through the closure scalar-extension composite by congrArg and compose the two equalities. Unfold scalarQChern and scalarP2Chern in the none branch: their definitions are exactly the two closure composites obtained this way.

proof_origin.place: Paragraphs (2)-(3), reducing the closure case to the existing finite rational Chern exchange and Chern-free scalar/exchange naturality.

mathlib_searches.query: Unit and Chern class split the derived direct image on a projective line, with trace values zero and one
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: projective resolutions, linear algebra direct-sum traces, and split maps of cochain complexes. No projective-line Chern splitting or sheaf trace.

mathlib_searches.query: Projective line Chern splitting normalized trace commutes with pullback base change
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits on normalized field traces, elliptic curves and LinearMap.trace_baseChange. None for the derived geometric trace.
biprod.desc, inl_desc, inr_desc and their reassociations. These are used for the categorical assembly; they do not construct the geometric generators.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use Mathlib biproduct calculus for assembly.

In the project, DiagonalCompletedChernLift constructs normalized completed adjuncts, DiagonalTraceTwistedSplittingComponents proves the strict-system components, and DiagonalUniformizerTraceChernDegree proves completed Chern degree privately. DiagonalTowerCoefficients.baseChange needs two families and completed cycle systems not present in this item.
